response.sql: WITH counts_by_hand AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) as count FROM manager_award ma INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), with_shares AS (SELECT throws, count, CAST(count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(count) OVER () as share FROM counts_by_hand), with_avg_share AS (SELECT throws, count, share, AVG(share) OVER () as avg_share FROM with_shares), above_avg AS (SELECT throws, count, share, avg_share FROM with_avg_share WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
